label_policy: Agent-authored, reviewer-steered development labels. 0=outside requested Explore review scope; 1=requires explanation. Import/module declarations, comments, formatting, test-only, docs, generated files and lockfiles are excluded by reviewer policy, even if they can alter behavior. Context lines are unscored. Labels are judgments, not objective ground truth.
